info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to unsubscribe from notifications about severe weather alerts. This endpoint serves as a crucial touchpoint for consumers seeking to manage their weather alert subscriptions effectively. By utilizing this API, users can ensure they only receive pertinent information, aligning with their preferences. Typical users include individuals and organizations that wish to streamline their communication regarding weather alerts. The API promotes user autonomy by providing a straightforward means of managing alert settings.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from alerts they have previously subscribed to, effectively removing their notification preferences.

requestBody.description: Request body for unsubscribing from alerts. Please provide the necessary details to successfully process the unsubscription.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.title: Unsubscribe Alert Request Body
DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for unsubscribing from alerts. It is expected to be a string, typically containing a reason for the unsubscription.

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number provided for tracking the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

audit.description: Audit details regarding the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation. This schema contains the status and details of the unsubscribe request.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the unsubscribe request.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the unsubscribe request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Schema containing audit information about the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
